notes: Onondaga elects county committee at the even-year primary: the BOE 2026 offices-to-be-filled list includes members of county committee, and the official June 23, 2026 primary candidates list shows one contested Republican committee race (Town of Pompey District 6, vote for 2). The BOE posts petition reports filtered to "Only Non-Committee Offices" and the primary candidates list covers contested races only, so no public list of all Republican county committee filers was found; empty/filled status cannot be determined for any ED. All 450 EDs are taken from the BOE 2026 Republican sample ballot guide, which lists every town/ward/district. Seats use 2 per ED (statutory minimum, consistent with the Pompey ED 6 "vote for 2"); Onondaga Republican committee rules were not found. Pompey ED 6 results were not checked because the other EDs could not be documented either; that ED is left unknown.
